name: P-channel MOSFET
description: A small P-channel MOSFET for switching the positive side of a load (a high-side switch): put the source (S) on the supply and the load between the drain (D) and GND. It turns on when the gate (G) is more than about 2 V below the source, so a LOW pin switches it on and HIGH (with S at 5 V) off. Add a pull-up from G to S. Up to 200 mA, about 5 Ω when on.
